Notice Of Petition To Approve Compromise Of Pending Action As To Minor
Off Calendar Jul-09-2013 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for a Hearing on a Minor's Compromise.
Department 514, Judge: Donald Sullivan, Clerk: Yolanda Mazariegos, CSR: Sonia Wong, #11288.
Nathaniel M. Leeds, Esq., appearing for Plaintiff(s) Petitioner: Kelly Lynch, mother and guardian ad litem for Minor: Connor Lynch present in court.
Petitioner sworn and examinded.
After testimony and consideration of the evidence presented, the Petition is granted and compromise is approved as follows:
Total Settlement: $142,500.00
Attorney's Fees: $23,374.64 payable to Law Offices of Nathaniel Leeds.
Reimbursement of $19,125.36 costs payable to the Law Offices of Nathaniel Leeds. This amount and the attorney's fees may be paid together in a single check.
A net balance of $100,000.00 to be deposited into a blocked account at Wells Fargo Bank San Rafael Main Branch 1203 4th Street, San Rafael, CA 94901 until Minor reaches the age of 18 years.
Court signed Order Granting approval of Minor and Order to Deposit Money into blocked Account.
Status Hearing Scheduled on November 7, 2013 at 9:00 AM, in Department 514 for filing of receipt for the deposit of money into blocked account. No appearance is required if the receipt is filed and courtesy copy lodge with Depart. 514 prior to Hearing.
